stages.name: The first one
stages.text: Woman on the corner, phone flat in her palm, following the blue dot instead of the road. One clean lift and you're into the crowd before she looks up.
stages.fail_text: Wrist strap you didn't clock. Now you're both holding the same phone and only one of you is embarrassed.

stages.name: One more in the crowd
stages.text: The precinct's rammed and everyone's got a phone out. Another mark, thirty feet on, headphones in, world switched off. The crowd hides you but it hides them clocking you too.
stages.fail_text: His mate saw. The mate's the problem, not him, and the mate's already shouting.

stages.name: The one filming
stages.text: A tourist holding the newest model out at arm's length, filming the whole street, you included. Worth triple the others — and pointed at your face right up until the second you take it.
stages.fail_text: The livestream had three hundred people watching, and now three hundred people have watched you do it in daylight.
